scope: Existing installed registry modules, synthetic loopback HTTP origin/proxy and scratch files only; no external requests, credentials or live exploit in the comparison

comparisons.fixture: 220ms local response delay and timeout.request=40ms; got retry disabled
comparisons.get5: completes because got timeout options are ignored

comparisons.fixture: Local HttpProxyAgent and distinguishable synthetic proxy/origin payloads
comparisons.get3: one proxy request and proxy bytes
comparisons.get5: zero proxy requests and direct origin bytes

comparisons.get3: HTTPError response.statusCode=503 matches current builder retry predicate
comparisons.get5: HTTPError response.status=503 does not match current builder predicate

comparisons.fixture: Generic artifact with supplied SHA256 and ReadWrite cache; two downloads followed by a Bypass download with deliberately incorrect checksum
comparisons.get3: one request for the two valid downloads; payload exact; rejects wrong checksum

interpretation: Eight actual-module cases reproduce three contract failures and preserve checksum/artifact-cache controls. A raw get5 override is rejected, not a completed compatible migration. The comparison does not model every request option, TLS/proxy configuration, Node development-floor behavior or platform package output.

verification.linuxPackageSmoke: Passed in a fresh Git-archive source fixture with the documentation delta and retained locked dependencies

repeatOnlyWhen: A source-verified repair or compatible downloader/toolchain candidate changes the relevant behavior. Qualify equivalent timeouts, explicit and environment proxies, retry/error behavior, TLS, mirrors, checksums, artifact cache modes and supported development hosts; do not repeat the unchanged raw-override comparison.
